title: Travelling
descriptionFa: وسیله‌های نقلیه، بلیت و برنامه‌ی حرکت، سفر با قطار و هواپیما و ماشین.

words.example: I take the bus to work every morning.
words.tipFa: by bus, by car, by bike: بدون a.

words.example: I ride my bike to university.
words.tipFa: اسم کاملش bicycle هست. ride a bike، نه drive.

words.example: My brother rides a motorbike to work.
words.tipFa: motorcycle هم می‌گن.

words.example: The injured climber was taken to hospital by helicopter.
The Tehran underground is fast and cheap.
words.tipFa: metro هم می‌گن. آمریکایی: subway. مال لندن: the Tube.

words.example: We rented a small boat on the lake.
The ship carried thousands of containers.
words.tipFa: ship خیلی بزرگ‌تر از boat هست.

words.example: I always use a map on my phone.
Check the timetable to see when the next train leaves.
words.tipFa: برنامه‌ی کلاس‌های مدرسه هم timetable هست.

words.meaningFa: سفر (مسیر رفتن از جایی به جایی)
words.example: The journey from Tehran to Tabriz takes about ten hours.
words.tipFa: Was the journey long? درسته، نه Was the travel long?

words.example: A single to Mashhad, please.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها one-way ticket می‌گن.

words.example: A return ticket is cheaper than two singles.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها round-trip ticket می‌گن.

words.example: We need to book our seats in advance.
words.tipFa: reserve هم می‌گن. in advance یعنی «از قبل».

words.example: The train will arrive at platform 2.
words.tipFa: به شهر: arrive in Shiraz. به یه جای کوچیک‌تر: arrive at the station.

words.example: The flight to Istanbul will depart at 7:15.
words.tipFa: توی حرف زدن معمولی leave می‌گیم.

words.example: The Isfahan train leaves from platform 4.
We had lunch in the restaurant car.
You have to change trains at the next station.
words.tipFa: trains با s: change trains.

words.example: Is there a direct flight to Toronto?
Did you check in online or at the airport?
words.tipFa: اسمش: check-in. توی هتل هم یعنی «ورود و تحویل اتاق».

words.example: Please show your boarding card at the gate.
words.tipFa: boarding pass هم می‌گن.

words.example: The flight attendant brought us some water.
The plane will take off in ten minutes.
words.tipFa: همون فعلیه که برای درآوردن لباس هم بود؛ اینجا معنی‌ش فرق داره.

words.example: We will land in Shiraz at half past nine.
words.tipFa: اسمش یعنی «زمین، خشکی».

words.example: At customs, they opened my suitcase.
words.tipFa: go through customs: از گمرک رد شدن. پاسپورت رو check می‌کنن، نه control.

words.example: We want to hire a car for a week in Turkey.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها rent a car می‌گن.

words.example: Petrol is cheaper in Iran than in Europe.
words.tipFa: آمریکایی‌ها gas می‌گن.

words.example: Fill up the tank before the long drive.
words.tipFa: fill it up with petrol.

words.example: Can I give you a lift to the station?
words.tipFa: give someone a lift. lift به تنهایی یعنی «آسانسور».
